description: This Java class defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application, providing consistent API error responses across the application. It handles specific exceptions such as NotFoundException, MethodArgumentNotValidException, and IllegalArgumentException, creating structured error responses with HTTP status codes and messages.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot controller advice class that catches specific exceptions globally and returns custom error responses.

methods.name: baseBody
methods.description: Constructs a standardized response body containing timestamp, status, error message, and custom message.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException, returning a 404 response with error details.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors from MethodArgumentNotValidException, returning a 400 response with field-specific error messages.

methods.name: handleIllegalArgument
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException, returning a 400 response with the exception message.
